sources.title: Pareto Sums of Pareto Sets: Lower Bounds and Algorithms
sources.snippet: In bi-criteria optimization problems, the goal is typically to compute the set of Pareto-optimal solutions. Many algorithms for these types of problems rely on efficient merging or combining of partial solutions and filtering of dominated solutions in the resulting sets. In this article, we consider the task of computing the Pareto sum of two given Pareto sets $A, B$ of size $n$.
